key_insight: X+Slides shows that slide-generation quality must be judged by audience-specific utility, not just completeness or polish.
engineering_relevance: For LLM-based slide tools, the benchmark provides a more realistic evaluation target by measuring whether presentations deliver the right information for specialists, decision-makers, or other audiences.
method: Built X+Slides from 113 topics across 7 presentation scenes.
Assigned audience-specific utility weights to compute Audience Coverage, Domain-wise Coverage, Efficiency, and Correctness.
evidence_signal: The benchmark evaluation uses 8,133 source-grounded probes and reports that DeepPresenter, SlideTailor, and NotebookLM can recover substantial but incomplete audience-essential information, with Audience Coverage up to 0.853 depending on the system and setting.
watch_item: High visual quality or broad topical coverage can still hide weak source grounding, so implementations should verify factual support for slide claims rather than relying on appearance alone.
